people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: David said to Saul, “Who am I, and what is my life, or my father’s family in Israel, that I should be son-in-law to the king?”
translations.bsb: And David said to Saul, “Who am I, and what is my family or my father’s clan in Israel, that I should become the son-in-law of the king?”
translations.kjv: And David said unto Saul, Who am I? and what is my life, or my father's family in Israel, that I should be son in law to the king?
translations.asv: And David said unto Saul, Who am I, and what is my life, or my father's family in Israel, that I should be son-in-law to the king?
